title: Tagish language
description: Extinct Athabaskan language of the Yukon
extract: Tagish is an extinct Athabaskan language spoken by the Tagish or Carcross-Tagish, a First Nations people that historically lived in the Northwest Territories and Yukon in Canada. The Tagish people refer to themselves as, literally "Tagish people", where is a place name meaning "it is breaking up".
